notes.title: Free DLC - Digital Content Pack
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28736442/10f298ed2543ca95c5f4aba81f3f83428534a9dc.png[/img]

If you have to stay at home and need some new wallpapers to keep your eyes fresh - we got you covered. Get the Runic Rampage Wallpaper and Avatar Pack for free!

The pack consists of:
[list]
[*] 4 Worldmap Wallpapers
[*] 4 Character Wallpapers
[*] 4 Story Wallpapers
[*] 2 Avatar Profile Pictures
[/list]

You find the Pack in the local directory of your Runic Rampage installation. (Right click on the game -> Manage -> Browse local files)

notes.title: Spring Update: Winning Streak!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/0543b0112defc3e1683d3f763368ac655c846beb.png[/img]
Heya Warriors!

Challenge yourself and test your fighting skills - how many random levels can you beat [u]in a row[/u]? Find out in the all new game mode [b]Winning Streak[/b].

[h1]How does Winning Streak work?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Start in Streak level 1
[*]Beat one random level
[*]Level up to Streak level 2
[*]Beat two random levels [u]in a row[/u]
[*]Level up to Streak level 3
[*]Beat three random levels [u]in a row[/u]
[*]Lost a game? Keep your Streak level and try again!
[*]How far can you make it?
[/list]
Like New Game Advanced, Winning Streak game mode is accessible after playing through the campaign.


[h1]Upcoming achievements[/h1]

Winning Streak game mode comes with new achievements, [b]wich unlock at 90 reviews[/b]! :)
So, Please write a review, claim your Winning Streak achievements and help to unlock more future updates.
Happy smashing! :)

[b]Update:[/b] I just added 7 new Achievements :)

Best.
Alex

notes.title: New Game Advanced Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/14583508036e397ddf931bc834641640c7e2dd4f.png[/img]
Greetings Warriors!

You asked for it in the discussions and now it is there: Prove that you are the dwarf you claim to be and beat the game in [b]New Game Advanced[/b]. 

[h1]New Game Advanced in detail[/h1]
[list]
[*]Restart the game in a higher difficulty
[*]Increase your maximum attribute points from 40 to 80
[*]Keep your character level and stats
[*]Recollect gold, weapons and sets
[*]Earn prestige
[*]Beat it in tier 1? Try to beat it in tier 2!
[*]Start over
[/list]

Please write a review - this helps me to keep the game alive! :)
Thanks and have fun! :)

Best,
Alex

One year ago I released the game and it is about to celebrate its 1st birthday on May 17. :)

Thank you for reviewing Runic Rampage!

notes.title: Recap, Patches and More!
notes.content:
Hi there,

today it's one month since release. Runic Rampage was well received by the press and is very positive rated here on Steam, which is super awesome! [b]Thank you all![/b] :)

[h1]Trading Cards[/h1]
I integrated trading cards. Take a glimpse:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28736442/9564a22a422d8e90040c9cd1aea9bc9556327419.png[/img]

[h1]Patches[/h1]
I released two minor updates with bug-fixes. List of changes:

[b]Patch 1.0.2 - 13 June 2017[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed pausing when losing focus in dual monitor setup
[*]fixed sometimes statistic shows wrong max combo 
[/list]

[b]Patch 1.0.1 - 19 May 2017[/b][list]
[*]fixed 2nd screen darkens on dual monitor setup
[*]fixed tutorial started with gamepad button instead mouse button when using mouse
[/list]

[h1]Coming soon[/h1]
I am [b]currently working on a major update[/b] with features requested in the discussions, as well as new language support. Stay tuned!

If you like Runic Rampage and want to support my work: [b]Please write a review.[/b] :)

Best.
Alex
